headline: Ipswich and Nottingham Forest share points after first-half goals

sentences.text: Ipswich Town and Nott'm Forest drew 1–1 in their Premier League matchweek 8 meeting, with both goals arriving before half-time.
Neco Williams put Nott'm Forest ahead in the 13th minute, assisted by Daniel Muñoz, before Julio Enciso equalised for Ipswich in the 41st.
The sides went in level at 1–1, and neither found a second-half goal.
Nott'm Forest had the greater attacking volume, recording 17 shots to Ipswich's 7 and 5 shots on target to 3.
The visitors also registered 2.29 expected goals against Ipswich's 0.46, despite possession being almost even at 50.6% to 49.4%.
The draw gave Ipswich a point and left them 9th on 10 points, while Nott'm Forest moved to 16th on 6 points.
